name: Sandboxer
summary: North Bay Opco I, Inc. cloud Ubuntu 24.04 microVMs for agents, with hosted MCP. Paid from $20/month; MIT MCP package; Florida law.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (listing-queue #52 was submitted by the Sandboxer team; claims below were checked on official sandboxer.com pages, npm, and read-only MCP probes — the queue text and UTM URL were not used as sources). Sandboxer is operated by North Bay Opco I, Inc., a Delaware corporation, mailing address 777 Brickell Ave, Suite 500 PMB 1074, Miami, FL 33131 (hello@sandboxer.com; support@sandboxer.com; legal@sandboxer.com). Official Terms: you must be at least 13, or older if the law where you live sets a higher minimum for using online services without a parent's consent; if you are under 18 (or under the age of majority where you live, if higher) you may use the Service only with a parent or legal guardian who agrees to the Terms and is responsible for the account and payments. Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida; the Federal Arbitration Act governs binding individual arbitration (class actions waived; opt out within 30 days). Official llms.txt and pricing: each sandbox is a full Ubuntu 24.04 Cloud Hypervisor microVM (root, systemd, Docker, nested KVM, SSH, a public HTTPS URL per port), not a container, on dedicated servers Sandboxer operates in us-east (Ashburn, Virginia) and eu-central (Helsinki, Finland). Stopping saves memory and disk; a stopped sandbox costs nothing for compute. Billing is per second while a sandbox runs. Sizes: small 2 vCPU / 4 GB / 12 GB disk at $0.018/h; default 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 50 GB at $0.036/h; large 8 vCPU / 16 GB / 125 GB at $0.072/h; xlarge 16 vCPU / 32 GB / 251 GB at $0.20/h. Plans: $20/month (100 at once), $100 (300), $500 (1,000), $2,000 (2,000); every plan dollar comes back as machine time; extra time comes in $20 packs that never expire. Official wording: no free trial; plans start at $20/month, charged when you subscribe; signing up, the docs and the dashboard need no card. Included time does not roll over. Official Terms: a cancelled subscription runs to the end of the current period and is not refunded for the rest of it; upgrades charge the prorated difference at once; downgrades take effect at the next renewal with no credit for the rest of the period. No SLA during early access; no GPUs. There is no official promise that idle auto-pause minutes in llms.txt (30 to 120 depending on the plan) are a hard spending cap. Host trust: sandboxes are root-capable VMs with Docker and optional public HTTPS URLs, running on Sandboxer's servers, not on the operator's laptop; documented curl|sh CLI install was not executed. The npm package sandboxer-mcp 0.1.0 (published 2026-10-24T21:32:22Z = 2026-10-24 23:32:22 Europe/Stockholm) is MIT according to the npm registry; no public GitHub repository was found. The hosted service is proprietary. Official docs: hosted MCP at https://sandboxer.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP) uses OAuth in browser clients or an API key in headless clients; local `sbx mcp` or `npx sandboxer-mcp` was not run. OpenAPI 3.1.0 title "Sandboxer Public API v1" version 1.0.0 at https://sandboxer.com/openapi.json (also yaml). No account, key, or spend; tools were not called.

agent_access.notes: Official docs: hosted Streamable HTTP at https://sandboxer.com/mcp; browser apps sign in with OAuth; headless clients send Authorization: Bearer <Sandboxer API key>. Bare GET and GET with Accept: application/json or text/event-stream returned HTTP 405 application/json JSON-RPC error "Method not allowed: POST JSON-RPC messages to this URL." with Allow: POST, DELETE, OPTIONS. Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list POSTs returned HTTP 401 JSON-RPC error "Unauthorized: send Authorization: Bearer <Sandboxer API key>, or sign in with OAuth." and WWW-Authenticate Bearer resource_metadata="https://sandboxer.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp", scope="sandboxer". Local npx/sbx MCP was not run. Tools were not called; no account, key, or spend.
